How much does it cost to run a hot tub?

A typical hot tub uses about 2500 kWh a year (1500–5000 kWh depending on size and efficiency). At the current price cap rate that's about £658 a year, or £54.83 a month.

Cost per year
£658
About £54.83 a month at 26.32p/kWh.

Standing charge not included.

Adjust for yours
Ofgem price cap average for 1 Oct – 31 Dec 2026 (standard variable tariff, Direct Debit, England, Scotland & Wales).

About these figures

Worth knowing: Varies hugely with cover, insulation and season.

Source for the typical figure: Typical range (estimate). See how we calculate.

Ways to cut the cost

  • Heat the room you're in, with the door shut, rather than the whole house.
  • Use the thermostat and a timer rather than the highest setting.
  • Heating yourself (a blanket or heated throw) costs far less than heating the air.

Questions

How much does it cost to run a hot tub per month?

About £54.83 a month for a model using 2500 kWh a year, at 26.32p/kWh.

Is the standing charge included?

No. You pay the standing charge every day whether or not the appliance is used, so it isn't part of the cost of running it.

How do I find my hot tub's actual power use?

Check the rating label, plug or manual for the wattage, or the energy label for kWh figures. A plug-in energy monitor shows exactly what it uses.
